source: LaMa (Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions, Suvorov et al., WACV 2022; https://github.com/advimman/lama), big-lama weights exported to ONNX by Carve at https://huggingface.co/Carve/LaMa-ONNX (model card license: apache-2.0)
licenseText: licenses/inpaint-lama.LICENSE.txt (upstream advimman/lama LICENSE, downloaded with the model by scripts/fetch_models.py)
trainingData: Places2/Places365; per the OpenCV Zoo LaMa entry the Places365 image-download terms are limited to non-commercial research and education. This project is non-commercial (decision D6); re-check before any commercial use.
notes: Fills painted areas (object removal) and found dust and scratches (old-photo repair). Fixed 512x512 input.
